orderingHelp: Uses deterministic UTF-16 text order, not language-specific or numeric order. Equal lines keep their original order. Ignore case also applies to duplicate detection; the first occurrence is kept.
lineEndingHelp: CRLF and CR line endings become LF. A final line ending counts as a blank line and is sorted with the other lines. Blank-line removal also removes whitespace-only lines.
privacyHelp: Text is processed in your browser and is not uploaded or saved.
